A3_replenishment_backtest.methodology: 6 evaluation point(s), every 10 days across the last 60 days, each recomputed with ingredient_forecast()'s own `now` parameter using only data that existed at that point, checked against real ledger balances 7 days later.

false_alarm_breakdown.note: 'resolved_by_restock': a real purchase_receipt ledger row landed for that exact ingredient within the check window -- the flag's own lead-time logic is what that window is keyed to, so this is at least as consistent with the warning having been acted on as with it being wrong. 'genuine': no such receiving event occurred, yet the ingredient never actually hit zero -- the model overestimated risk with no restocking to explain why.

observable_windows.note: Same as `confusion`, but skips evaluation points whose 7-day check window recorded under 25% of a normal week's orders (a data-collection gap or closure). With no trading, no stock outcome can have been driven by demand, so a flag there is neither confirmed nor refuted. `confusion` above still includes them.

within_window_label.note: Stockout = balance <= 0 at any point inside the check window (what the docstring has always claimed), instead of only at its end. Same flags, same forecasts.

any_warning.note: Positive = critical, out OR at_risk, against the same end-of-window label. at_risk means 'depletes after the lead time but within lead + review cycle' -- ordering today still prevents it, so it is not part of the primary flag.

A3_replenishment_backtest.adjusted_precision_note: Excludes false_alarm_breakdown.resolved_by_restock from the false-alarm count -- see that field's note. critical_flag_precision above is kept unchanged alongside this for comparison.

A5_anomaly_stock_loss_scientific.detail: 0 labeled sample(s) under this model/eligibility version (0 on the flagged side, 0 on the unflagged side). Needs >= 20 total and >= 5 on each side of the model's own prediction before Precision/Recall/Specificity can be reported rather than guessed at.

B1_stock_loss_vs_injected_truth.methodology: Wastage Log + Stock Counts + Receiving Log rows from simulatedd.xlsx replayed into an isolated, throwaway database (never production) against REAL ingredient reference rows copied read-only from the live database. Ground truth is the workbook's own 'Injected Synthetic Truth' column, read directly.

default_thresholds.description: detect_anomalies() as shipped: rule layer (fraction>=0.25) OR IsolationForest capped to the worst 10% of the pool.

calibrated.calibration_method: Chronological 60/40 split; decision threshold = the IsolationForest score cutoff maximizing F1 on the train fold only, applied unchanged to the test fold. ROC-AUC/PR-AUC computed on the test fold's continuous scores (threshold-free).

B2_unli_consumption_vs_injected_truth.methodology: Unli Reconciliation rows from simulatedd.xlsx aggregated per service_date (summed across all 14 flavours, a single shared base unit) into one day-level stream and replayed into an isolated, throwaway database. Ground truth: a day is anomalous if any flavour that day carried INJECTED_CONSUMPTION_ANOMALY.

calibrated.calibration_method: Chronological 60/40 split; decision threshold = the IsolationForest score cutoff maximizing F1 on the train fold only, applied unchanged to the test fold. ROC-AUC/PR-AUC computed on the test fold's continuous scores (threshold-free).

B3_flavor_consumption_vs_injected_truth.methodology: Unli Reconciliation rows from simulatedd.xlsx replayed into an isolated, throwaway database (never production) against REAL unli_flavor/ingredient reference rows copied read-only from the live database. Ground truth is the workbook's own 'Injected Synthetic Truth' column, read directly.
